description: Creates a Stripe Checkout link that buys one Debriefing plan for this workspace. It charges nothing. The admin opens the link in a browser, checks the price, and pays there. Give the link to the person; never complete the payment for them. The link expires after 24 hours. Admin only. Send an idempotency_key. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the first answer and does not act again.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make for this request, such as a UUID. Send the same key when you retry, and Debriefing returns the first answer instead of acting twice.

interval.description: Bill each month (the default) or each year.

plan.description: The plan to buy. get_plan_and_limits shows the current plan.

name: create_checkout_link

replayed.description: True when this answer repeats an earlier call with the same idempotency_key.

title: Create a checkout link
